geometry_feedback.note: Effective declaration dimensions, not verified drawing dimensions. Bare world values mean metres. Compare with original annotations; no unit or scale is inferred.

agent_assumptions: Interior partition/corridor wall thickness treated as zero per geometry contract; centerlines derived from measured pixel gaps and labeled dimension chains (250mm corridor walls per label; ~120mm vertical office dividers inferred from pixel measurement to make the 15000mm chain sum exactly).
Interior corridor-to-office door widths/positions are approximated from visible arc/frame symbols near the bay-dividing partitions; exact widths not individually dimensioned in the drawing.
All interior door heights (corridor-office doors) assumed standard 2.1m; not dimensioned in the drawing.
East 1F window height family assumed same as North/South 1F windows (sill1.0/head2.6m); not independently re-derived from a separate East elevation internal dimension chain.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Exact interior door widths at each office-corridor junction are approximate; original arcs partially overlap adjacent partitions and were not individually pixel-measured to sub-100mm precision.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.
